text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I are discussing the
details
of next year's trip abroad—flight
times, training
locations, and more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whew... Can we watch a little TV?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly realize we've been at it for
three hours. We're both probably feeling
mentally drained. I
pick up the remote
and switch on the TV.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take a short break.
Yeah, let's take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's time for this year's Comedy Grand Prix! Which of our comedy duos will succeed in this revival match?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a big comedy contest that's been
airing
annually.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who's going to make it to the
finals this
year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not particularly...
choice_data_list: You like comedy?
You're into comedy?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The results of the comeback match will be
announced shortly! Take a guess at who our
winners might be, and we'll be
right back with the answer after the
break!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Which duo do you think will win? The
contestants
are numbered from one to
ninety-nine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa has a grin on her face.
Guessing
the winners is probably just
another fun little
game for her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who cares? I haven't seen them all
either.
choice_data_list: I haven't even seen their routine,...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
How about this... if you guess correctly,
I'll treat
you to some tasty holiday
chicken.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But if I guess correctly, you've gotta
treat me to
dinner. You're probably
getting pretty hungry by
now, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just choose a number and worry about
that later.
The commercials are almost
over.
choice_data_list: What if both of you are wrong to b...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Nakayama Festa rushing me along,
I blurt
out a random number without
thinking. The result
is...
choice_data_list: Then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here, some holiday chicken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the bag Nakayama Festa hands
me is a
regular piece of fried chicken
from the
convenience store.
choice_data_list: Well then, time to dig in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hitting a one-in-ninety-nine gamble on
the first
try—that was a really lucky
guess.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's good. Keep sharpening
them even
more then.
choice_data_list: Maybe your senses were just height...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... How enthusiastic.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Has the chicken prize gotten you fired
up?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...
choice_data_list: Because reading the race requires ...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why does everything have to be about
racing
with you? You're too serious for
your own good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I finish off my fried chicken and
head
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Nakayama Festa rushing me along,
I blurt
out a random number without
thinking. The result
is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The oyster bar I looked up before
should be
around this area.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All that talk about France has given me
a serious
craving for oysters.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: They're good. 'Nuff said.
choice_data_list: You liked oysters that much, huh?
You really liked oysters that much...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's one of those fun foods where
you never
know if it'll come back to bite
ya tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As it turns out, oysters are a staple of
French
cuisine. That explains how
Nakayama Festa got
the craving.
choice_data_list: I might have a hard time relating ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the trip, though, we'll need to
focus on winning races rather than
testing our luck with
oysters. It'll be off
the menu after we've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? Don't tell me you didn't
bring
enough cash.
choice_data_list: ï¼â¦â¦An expedition to France, ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm thinking over our eventual trip, an
idea
comes to mind.
choice_data_list: No, I was thinking about something...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if I found another trainer to watch
over her
for a brief period?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what're you talking about? Did the
TV show
we watched get to your head?
choice_data_list: Duos and venues have their own che...
Duos and venues have their own che...

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yochie! Are you watching? I did it!
I made it
through to the finals!

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said.
Looks like I've got
a knack
for this!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The comedian split up with his previous
partner last year and formed the new
duo we saw today. Now, it looks like
things are finally starting to
take off for him.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
They say that some people just click.
That
connection can change the course
of your career
and your life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yup. That'll happen sometimes. We all
need
support, but who we ask depends
on the time and
circumstance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The person you're with at present might
not be
the one who can bring out your
full potential.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I ever fall into that situation,
I'd better
keep my
head straight.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't want to make things miserable for
the other
person, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, don't you dare run away.
choice_data_list: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Your job's not over yet. You've still
gotta treat
me to a hearty oyster feast.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is it really? Weren't you the one who
tried to
change the subject first to throw
me off?
choice_data_list: What?! Of course, that's the plan,...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go before you change
your mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sure, sure. I'll believe you when the
check has
arrived.
choice_data_list: I'm not running away, I promise I'...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
('Cause I mean it. You're not slipping
away from
me.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Maybe there's a trainer out there who can get along with me better, but no one can make me shine like you do.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(You and I are two sides of the same
coin, after
all.)
